name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Darnassus, young human and dwarven priests find guidance in another faith. Priestess Alathea teaches the ways of Elune, while followers of the Holy Light are directed to Stormwind. There, High Priestess Laurena welcomes the returning acolyte to the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: Two Paths of Faith
sections.body: Alliance priests follow different sacred paths. In Darnassus, the priesthood tends to Elune, channeling the moon goddess's radiance and wrath. Priestess Alathea honors Elune and respects the Holy Light, but cannot teach another race the deeper prayers bound to a different devotion. Human and dwarven acolytes who seek those prayers must look elsewhere.

sections.title: Return to the Cathedral
sections.body: Initiates of the Holy Light return home to learn its rites, including the prayer for divine aid in a moment of peril. High Priestess Laurena guides returning priests in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, beneath its marble arches.

faq.q: Why does a Darnassus priest send me to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea teaches the ways of Elune. She respects the Holy Light, but cannot teach its prayers to humans and dwarves, who seek guidance from High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
Priestess Alathea is a night elf priestess at Darnassus's Temple of the Moon. She mentors aspiring followers of Elune and offers respectful guidance to visiting priests of other faiths.
High Priestess Laurena is a human spiritual leader in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. She instructs servants of the Holy Light in advanced prayers and their responsibilities.

faq.q: What is Desperate Prayer in the lore?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer calls for divine aid when a priest is near death or in mortal peril. It is an invocation of the Holy Light that can bring immediate restoration.

faq.q: Can night elves teach the Holy Light?
aliases: do night elves know the light
faq.answer: No. Night elves revere Elune almost exclusively and channel her lunar power. They respect the Holy Light, but do not preach it or teach its prayers; those belong to human and dwarven priests.

faq.q: Where can I find High Priestess Laurena?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena resides in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City, inside the Cathedral of Light among clergy and paladins of the Silver Hand.

angles.text: As a priest, you see the Alliance's holy magic divided between worship of Elune and devotion to the Holy Light.
As a human priest far from home, you are reminded that your spiritual home and training await in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.
As a dwarven priest, you share close ties with Stormwind's cathedral and learn high rites alongside your human brethren.
As a night elf, you acknowledge foreign faiths with courtesy while remaining devoted to the Mother Moon alone.
